cases.prompt: I want to begin building Canvas Code Components in a fresh Drupal site. What is the quickest way to scaffold a project?
expected: gives the npx @drupal-canvas/create command with a project name
says the scaffold includes Drupal core with the Canvas module, example components and development tooling
mentions the Nebula starter template is part of what is created
must_not: tells the user to assemble Canvas by hand from a plain drupal/recommended-project install

cases.prompt: I need deeper guidance on defining components, metadata and uploading them to Drupal than a quick overview. Where do I get it?
expected: points to installing the Canvas skills collection with npx skills add drupal-canvas/skills
says the collection covers 7 topics such as definition, metadata, composability, styling, utilities, data fetching and upload

cases.prompt: What files make up a Canvas Code Component and what does each one do?
expected: lists the .component.tsx file as the component logic
lists the .metadata.json file as the Drupal integration metadata
lists the .styles.css file as scoped styles
describes the .utils.ts file as optional

cases.prompt: Is a Canvas Code Component just a client-side React widget, or does Drupal render it on the server?
expected: says components are server-side rendered with hydration
says they are not client-only
mentions they can access Drupal entities, fields, views and APIs
must_not: describes Canvas Code Components as purely client-side rendered
grounded_in: **Server-side rendered** — Full SSR with hydration, not client-only
**Drupal-integrated** — Access entities, fields, views, and Drupal APIs
